params.value: ($1), who needs the tutorial? Click on the players or select from the middle.

preset.text: A secret word is picked and its letters are dealt out to all of you. Talk it out, give each other clues about what letters you hold, and try to spell the word together.

The board starts with one empty deck. Whoever clicks it first places a letter from their hand. After that, you can only place letters on the leftmost or rightmost end of the row — extending the word in either direction.
After every placement, the letters on the board must still form a substring of the secret word. If you ever break that, the round ends and nobody scores.
Your score (the big number) shows how many letters you're holding; the smaller number is how many of those are vowels. Spell the secret word together to get a group point!
